title: File upload through a Server Action fails with 'Body exceeded 1 MB limit'
symptoms: Uploads of small images work and larger ones fail with a 413 or an unhandled action error
cause: Server Actions cap the request body at 1 MB by default to limit parsing cost and abuse. FormData with a file counts toward that cap.
fix: Raise serverActions.bodySizeLimit to what you actually need, or upload large files straight to object storage with a presigned URL and send only the key to the action.
affected: Next.js 14 to 16.4, App Router Server Actions
